modelDescription: The Savage Arms AXIS XP Compact blends affordability and accuracy, with a compact, fast-handling design. The rifle features a carbon-steel barrel, the Axis synthetic stock and a matte-black finish. It comes mounted and boresighted with a 3-9x40mm Weaver scope and offers silky-smooth bolt operation.
